title: Affine closed charts with exact pushforward and normalized dualizing composition
statement: Fix $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ of characteristic $p$, a prime $\ell\ne p$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi$, and $1\le m\le n$. Set $A=\mathcal O_E/(\varpi^n)$, $B=\mathcal O_E/(\varpi^m)$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber]. For a separated finite-type $k$-scheme $Y$ [def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-finite-type-morphism], write $a_Y:Y\to s=\operatorname{Spec}k$, $F_{Y,R}=Ra_{Y,R!}\dashv G_{Y,R}=a_{Y,R}^{\times}$, $\omega_{Y,R}=G_{Y,R}R_s$, and $\varepsilon_{Y,R}:F_{Y,R}\omega_{Y,R}\to R_s$, for $R=A,B$, on ordinary small etale module derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-amb-etale-compact-support, thm-amb-etale-exceptional-adjoint]. Let $T_Y=-\otimes_A^LB$ [def-kun-derived-tensor], and denote the canonical compact-support coefficient comparison by $c_{Y,K}:T_sF_{Y,A}K\to F_{Y,B}T_YK$ [lem-fix-compact-support-coefficient-change]. Here bounded constructible finite-Tor means constructible cohomology, zero outside a finite interval, and integers $a\le b$ such that tensoring with every degree-zero module sheaf has cohomology only in $[a,b]$ [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes, def-kun-tor-amplitude]. Let $Y$ be affine. There are $r\ge0$ and a closed immersion $i:Y\hookrightarrow P=\mathbf A^r_k$ with $a_Y=pi$, where $p:P\to s$ is projection [def-weil-closed-immersion]. This is a finite proper finite-type morphism. For its identity-open compactification the functor $Ri_{R!}=Ri_{R*}$ is exact termwise $i_{R*}$ on the whole ordinary derived categories, and $H^q(i_{R*}L)=i_{R*}H^q(L)$. Its ordinary right adjoint $I_R=Ri_R^!$ [lem-exc-closed-ambient] preserves bounded-below objects. There are canonical counit-compatible identifications $\omega_{Y,R}\cong I_R\omega_{P,R}$ and $\varepsilon_{Y,R}=\varepsilon_{P,R}\circ F_{P,R}(e_{R,\omega_{P,R}})$, where $e_{R,H}:i_{R*}I_RH\to H$ is the closed exceptional counit and $F_Y\cong F_Pi_*$ is the bounded-below compact-support composition comparison [lem-amb-etale-compact-comparisons, def-weil-pbc-composite-adjunction]. Both representing objects in this last identification are bounded below independently of coefficient change.
